description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for testing the ConfigService component within the OrangeHRM project. It contains multiple unit tests validating methods related to configuration management such as getting/setting configuration values, handling exceptions, and verifying interactions with the ConfigDao dependency.

classes.name: ConfigServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing the ConfigService functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment and creates a new instance of ConfigService before each test.

methods.name: testGetSetConfigDao
methods.description: Verifies that getConfigDao returns an instance of ConfigDao and that setConfigDao correctly updates it.

methods.name: testSetShowPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Tests the behavior of setting 'Show PIM Deprecated Fields' configuration value.

methods.name: testShowPimDeprecatedFields
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Show PIM Deprecated Fields' configuration value.

methods.name: testSetShowPimSSN
methods.description: Tests the behavior of setting 'Show PIM SSN' configuration value.

methods.name: testShowPimSSN
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Show PIM SSN' configuration value.

methods.name: testSetShowPimSIN
methods.description: Tests setting the 'Show PIM SIN' option.

methods.name: testShowPimSIN
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Show PIM SIN' configuration value.

methods.name: testSetShowPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Tests setting the 'Show PIM Tax Exemptions' option, including exception handling.

methods.name: testShowPimTaxExemptions
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Show PIM Tax Exemptions' configuration value and exception handling.

methods.name: testSetSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Tests setting the 'Supervisor Chain Supported' configuration.

methods.name: testIsSupervisorChainSupported
methods.description: Tests retrieval of the 'Supervisor Chain Supported' setting.

methods.name: testGetDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the default work shift start time.

methods.name: testSetDefaultWorkShiftStartTime
methods.description: Validates setting of the default work shift start time.

methods.name: testGetDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Validates retrieval of the default work shift end time.

methods.name: testSetDefaultWorkShiftEndTime
methods.description: Validates setting of the default work shift end time.

methods.name: testGetAllValues
methods.description: Checks retrieval of all configuration key-value pairs.

methods.name: validateGetMethod
methods.description: Helper method to validate getter methods for configuration values.

methods.name: validateSetMethod
methods.description: Helper method to validate setter methods for configuration values.

methods.name: testSetOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Tests setting the OpenID Provider Added configuration.

methods.name: testGetOpenIdProviderAdded
methods.description: Tests retrieving the OpenID Provider Added configuration.

methods.description: Validates retrieval of the timesheet period configuration.
